name: Banana Bunch
card_quote: "I like CT but I can't commit to playing every day. I want something more laid back."
card_desc: Banana Bunch has you covered. A relaxed CT team focused on learning at your own pace. Use at least some attacks each day and enjoy the event without the pressure.
modal_quote: "I like CT but I can't commit to playing every day. I want something more laid back."
modal_desc: Banana Bunch is a low-pressure CT team focused on giving players a relaxed environment to learn the event and enjoy it. If you want to take part in CT without strict requirements weighing on you, this is a good home. Use at least some of your attacks each day, pick things up as you go, and play at a pace that works for you.
requirements: At least some daily attacks — contribute what you can
Willingness to learn — Bunch is a learning environment
Respectful attitude — everyone is at a different stage, and that's fine
No minimum score requirements — just participate and engage
